description: Pacific Punk Wave is a visual design movement prominent from the late 1970s and 1980s that mixes Pacific New Wave music, punk rebellion, Italian radical design and Swiss New Wave typography. It was heavily influenced by interior, post- modern graphics, and fashion trends, serving as a precursor to styles like New Wave Tropical and Memphis Lite . It paved the way for the 1980s/1990s post-modern commercial aesthetic, inspiring digital design revivals like vector graphics and synthwave .
